title: Add-ons Management
subtitle: Control which add-ons customers can see and install in the store. This is separate from what any academy has installed.
emptyDescription: No add-on matches the current search and filter.

impact.draft: Customers will not see this add-on in the store at all, and it cannot be installed. Academies that already have it keep it.
impact.coming_soon: Customers will see this add-on in the store with a "Coming Soon" label, but cannot install it yet.
impact.published: Customers will see this add-on in the store and can install it under the usual entitlement rules. Publishing does not install or enable it for anyone.

dialog.title: Change catalog status for {{name}}
dialog.subtitle: This moves the add-on from {{from}} to {{to}} for every customer.

arabicText.notSet: Not set — the English name is shown
arabicText.title: Arabic name for {{name}}
arabicText.description: Customers using Atlas in Arabic see these in the store and at checkout instead of the English name and description. Leave a field empty to show the English text.
arabicText.stale: Someone else changed this add-on. Close and open it again to see the latest version.

price.title: Price of {{name}}
price.description: The price customers pay when they add this add-on. Prices are in Egyptian pounds.
price.billingCycleHelp: The billing cycle stays as it is.
price.billingCycleHelpFirstPrice: An add-on priced for the first time is billed monthly.
price.newPurchasesOnly_one: The new price applies to new purchases only. {{countText}} organization already has this add-on and isn’t charged again.
price.newPurchasesOnly_other: The new price applies to new purchases only. {{countText}} organizations already have this add-on and aren’t charged again.
price.newPurchasesNone: The new price applies to new purchases only. No organization has this add-on yet.
price.stale: Someone else changed this add-on. Close and open it again to see the latest version.
